notes: Access: HTTP fetch tier only, no blocks encountered. Investigation performed: (1) enumerated all 65 published collections via /collections.json -- scanned every handle and title for clearance/outlet/sale/final/discount/end-of-line signal words (English and common transliterations) -- zero matches; full list includes things like 'Best Sellers', 'New Additions', 'High Value Products', 'Overseas selling products', named material lines (Wabi Sabi, Uncork, Elements, Dori, etc.) and fixture-type collections, but nothing clearance/outlet/sale-themed. (2) Cross-checked against /sitemap_collections_1.xml (73 handles, a superset including a few stale/leftover entries like 'Untitled','Website','table','wall','ceiling','pendent','floor-lamp-redone','light6') -- same zero matches for clearance/outlet/sale/discount/final keywords. (3) Inspected homepage main nav and footer menu HTML directly -- no 'Sale', 'Clearance', 'Outlet', or 'Offers' menu item anywhere; only links present are to fixture-type collections (Pendant/Wall/Floor/Table/Ceiling Lamps), named material lines (Fibre Fables, Wabi Sabi, Oxide/colour, Shadow Play, Uncork, Elements, Dori), and the Worldwide Range/overseas collections. (4) Ran site search for 'sale' and 'clearance' (/search?q=...&type=product) -- both returned non-zero but non-discriminating counts (40 and 45 'results' respectively) on a site with only 339 total products; this is consistent with a default/fuzzy-fallback search rather than genuine clearance matches (same false-signal pattern this project has seen before, just inverted -- non-zero fuzzy noise instead of zero-result suppression). (5) The only 'sale' occurrences anywhere in rendered HTML are the Shopify theme's standard CSS class 'sale-price' / label 'Sale price' used for EVERY product's current price (a generic theme convention, not a clearance/markdown program) -- confirmed this is cosmetic, not a merchandising concept. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale-type merchandising PLP exists on this site; it is a focused lighting brand with curated/named collections and category listings only, no permanent-markdown program found.
